title: From Reactive to Autonomous: Evolution of AI Operations in Cloud Network Infrastructure
abstract: arXiv:2608.14574v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The operational model for cloud network infrastructure has undergone a fundamental transformation over the past decade. What began as manual, human-driven troubleshooting has evolved through scripted automation, rule-based systems, and AI-assisted operations into fully autonomous incident resolution. This paper traces the evolution of AI operations (AIOps) in cloud network infrastructure, identifying the architectural patterns, organizational challenges, and technical inflection points that enabled each generational transition. translated_title: 从被动响应到自主运维：云网络基础设施中AI运维的演进
translated_abstract: 云网络基础设施的运维模式在过去十年中经历了根本性的转变。从最初的人工驱动故障排查，逐步演进到脚本化自动化、基于规则的系统和AI辅助运维，最终实现完全自主的事件解决。本文追溯了云网络基础设施中AI运维（AIOps）的演进过程，识别了推动每一代技术转型的架构模式、组织挑战和技术拐点。基于超大规模网络基础设施的生产运维经验，我们提出了一个成熟度模型，该模型刻画了五个不同的运维世代，分析了阻碍世代间过渡的技术和组织障碍，并记录了表明更高自主性准备就绪的指标。我们表明，从被动响应到自主运维的路径不仅仅是技术层面的变革。
tldr: 本文提出了一个五阶段成熟度模型，系统分析了云网络基础设施中AI运维从人工到自主的演进路径，并识别了推动各阶段转型的关键技术拐点和组织障碍。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a five-stage maturity model that systematically analyzes the evolution of AIOps in cloud network infrastructure from manual to autonomous operations, identifying key technical inflection points and organizational barriers driving each generational transition.
